title: Great Migration Safari
overview: Follow the herds through both halves of the Mara–Serengeti ecosystem, with time in the conservancies for quieter viewing and night drives.
highlights: Mara River crossing points with a specialist guide
Private conservancy access away from the main reserve
Two nights in the northern Serengeti

itinerary.title: Nairobi to the Mara
itinerary.detail: Light-aircraft transfer to the Mara, afternoon game drive and camp briefing.

itinerary.title: Mara reserve and river
itinerary.detail: Full day in the reserve, with time at the river crossing points and a picnic lunch on the plains.

itinerary.title: Conservancy day
itinerary.detail: Morning and late-afternoon drives in the conservancy, with a guided walk where permitted.

itinerary.title: Cross into the Serengeti
itinerary.detail: Road transfer across the border with game viewing en route, arriving at a northern Serengeti camp.

itinerary.title: Northern Serengeti
itinerary.detail: Full day following the herds and the river line.

itinerary.title: Serengeti to Arusha
itinerary.detail: Final morning drive, then a flight to Arusha for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.detail: Transfer for your international flight or onward extension to Zanzibar.

accommodation: Tented safari camps in the Mara conservancy and northern Serengeti, chosen for location and quiet rather than star ratings.
transport: Light aircraft and 4×4 safari vehicles with a guide throughout; cross-border road transfer between the Mara and the Serengeti.
inclusions: Park and conservancy fees as quoted
important: Migration timing varies with rainfall and cannot be guaranteed on specific dates. River crossings are wildlife events, not scheduled sightings.

title: Serengeti Balloon & Plains Safari
overview: A short, focused Serengeti trip built around the quietest hour of the day — a dawn balloon over the plains, then game drives through the kopjes.
highlights: Dawn balloon flight with bush breakfast

itinerary.title: Arusha to the Serengeti
itinerary.detail: Flight to Seronera, afternoon drive and camp arrival.

itinerary.title: Balloon at dawn
itinerary.detail: Early launch over the plains, landing breakfast, then a slow drive back through the valleys.

itinerary.title: Full day in the park
itinerary.detail: Morning and afternoon drives across the central plains, with a picnic lunch.

itinerary.title: Kopjes and cats
itinerary.detail: A day focused on predator territory around the kopjes, with an evening drive.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.detail: Morning drive and flight out of the Serengeti.

accommodation: A central Serengeti tented camp with views over the plains.
transport: Light aircraft to Seronera and 4×4 game drives throughout.
important: Balloon flights are weather-dependent and subject to weight limits and operator availability.

title: Zanzibar Coast Retreat
overview: Two unhurried days in Stone Town, then the northern coast for warm water, reef snorkelling and slow evenings.

itinerary.title: Arrive Stone Town
itinerary.detail: Transfer and an evening walk along the waterfront.

itinerary.title: Stone Town and spice
itinerary.detail: Morning heritage walk, afternoon spice farm visit.

itinerary.title: To the north coast
itinerary.detail: Transfer north, with the afternoon free at the beach.

itinerary.title: Reef day
itinerary.detail: Snorkelling trip to Mnemba Atoll with a dhow sail.

itinerary.title: Free day
itinerary.detail: Time at the coast, or an optional cooking class in the village.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.detail: Transfer to the airport.

accommodation: A restored Stone Town house, then a small beach property on the northern coast.
transport: Private transfers; boat for the reef trip.
important: Reef trips depend on sea conditions. Zanzibar is a conservative coastal society; modest dress away from the beach is appreciated.

title: Gorilla Highlands Trek
overview: A short, focused trek into the Bwindi forest to spend a permitted hour with a habituated mountain gorilla family.

itinerary.title: Kampala to the highlands
itinerary.detail: Domestic flight or scenic drive to the Bwindi area.

itinerary.title: Trek day
itinerary.detail: Early briefing, then trekking with ranger guides; one hour with the gorillas.

itinerary.title: Forest and community
itinerary.detail: Slower day: forest walk, community coffee project, rest.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.detail: Return to Kampala or Entebbe.

accommodation: A forest-edge lodge within reach of the trekking trailheads.
transport: Road transfers or domestic flight; trekking on foot with guides.
important: Gorilla permits are limited and must be secured well in advance. Trekking involves steep, dense forest and can take several hours.

title: Cape Town & Winelands Journey
overview: City days, the peninsula drive and three nights among the vineyards, at an unhurried pace.

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.detail: Airport transfer; evening at the waterfront.

itinerary.title: Mountain and city
itinerary.detail: Cableway or early hike, then the city centre and gardens.

itinerary.title: Peninsula day
itinerary.detail: Chapman’s Peak, Cape Point and the penguin colony.

itinerary.title: To the winelands
itinerary.detail: Drive inland; afternoon tasting in Stellenbosch.

itinerary.title: Vineyards
itinerary.detail: Full day of estate visits in Stellenbosch and Franschhoek.

itinerary.title: Free day in the valley
itinerary.detail: Time at leisure, or a longer hike.

itinerary.title: Back to the coast
itinerary.detail: Return to Cape Town for a final night.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.detail: Transfer to the airport.

accommodation: A small city hotel, then a guest farm in the winelands.
important: Table Mountain access depends on wind and cloud; the itinerary flexes around conditions.

title: Amboseli Elephants & Kilimanjaro
overview: A compact first safari: elephant families in the swamps, wide dust plains and, on clear mornings, the mountain behind them.

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Amboseli
itinerary.detail: Road transfer with the afternoon free, then an evening drive.

itinerary.title: Full park day
itinerary.detail: Sunrise drive, midday rest, late-afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Swamps and community
itinerary.detail: Morning among the elephants, afternoon conservancy visit.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.detail: Early drive and transfer back to Nairobi.

accommodation: A lodge or tented camp with a view toward the mountain.
transport: Road transfer from Nairobi and 4×4 game drives.
important: Kilimanjaro is often hidden by cloud; clear views are never guaranteed.

title: Victoria Falls & Chobe
overview: The falls on foot, the river from a boat, and a day across the border in Chobe where the elephant herds gather.

itinerary.title: Arrive Victoria Falls
itinerary.detail: Transfer, then a guided walk through the rainforest viewpoints.

itinerary.title: River day
itinerary.detail: Morning at leisure, sunset cruise on the Zambezi.

itinerary.title: Chobe
itinerary.detail: Cross into Botswana for a river cruise and game drive.

itinerary.title: Adventure or rest
itinerary.detail: Optional rafting, helicopter flight or a quiet day.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.detail: Transfer to the airport.

accommodation: A small hotel within walking distance of the falls.
transport: Transfers and a cross-border day vehicle for Chobe.
important: Cross-border trips require valid documents for both countries. Water levels affect which activities run.

title: Maasai Cultural Immersion
overview: A hosted stay with a Maasai family and community guides, with time in the conservancy rather than the reserve.

itinerary.title: Into the conservancy
itinerary.detail: Transfer in, welcome, and an evening walk with a community guide.

itinerary.title: A day hosted
itinerary.detail: Morning with the family, afternoon game drive in the conservancy.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.detail: Final morning, then transfer back to Nairobi.

accommodation: A community-owned camp in the conservancy.
important: Visits are arranged with host families and paid for directly. Photography is by permission only.
